definition: a small brown and grey bird common in towns
sentence: A {sparrow} picked up crumbs under the cafe table.
translation: Воробей подбирал крошки под столиком кафе.

definition: a gradual increase in the amount of something over time
sentence: The {accumulation} of snow on the roof became dangerous.
translation: Скопление снега на крыше стало опасным.

definition: a feeling of great respect and liking
sentence: She looked at the climber with {admiration}.
translation: Она смотрела на альпиниста с восхищением.

definition: the study of beauty, or the qualities that make something beautiful
sentence: The building is praised for its {aesthetics} more than its comfort.
translation: Здание хвалят за красоту больше, чем за удобство.

definition: demanding complete obedience and allowing no freedom
sentence: The {authoritarian} regime banned all opposition newspapers.
translation: Авторитарный режим запретил все оппозиционные газеты.

definition: a large formal meal for many people, often to celebrate something
sentence: The wedding {banquet} had ten courses and lasted five hours.
translation: Свадебный банкет из десяти блюд длился пять часов.

definition: the quality of being brave
sentence: The firefighter received a medal for {bravery}.
translation: Пожарный получил медаль за храбрость.

definition: in a cruel and violent way, or in a very direct and honest way
sentence: The reviewer was {brutally} honest about the film.
translation: Критик был беспощадно честен в оценке фильма.

definition: the ability of things or people to exist or work well together
sentence: Check the {compatibility} of the printer with your laptop before buying.
translation: Проверь совместимость принтера с ноутбуком, прежде чем покупать.

definition: depending on something else being true or happening
sentence: The offer is {conditional} on passing the medical exam.
translation: Предложение действует при условии прохождения медосмотра.

definition: the outer layer of the brain or of another organ
sentence: The visual {cortex} at the back of the brain processes what we see.
translation: Зрительная кора в задней части мозга обрабатывает то, что мы видим.

definition: not afraid to do something hard or dangerous
sentence: It was {courageous} of her to speak against the boss.
translation: С её стороны было смело выступить против начальника.

definition: believing that people only act for their own benefit
sentence: Years in politics made him {cynical} about promises.
translation: Годы в политике сделали его циничным в отношении обещаний.

definition: a powerful explosive used in mining and building
sentence: The workers used {dynamite} to clear the rock from the tunnel.
translation: Рабочие использовали динамит, чтобы расчистить туннель от камня.

definition: not using more money, fuel or time than necessary
sentence: A small car is more {economical} for city driving.
translation: Маленькая машина экономичнее для езды по городу.

definition: able to stretch and return to its original shape
sentence: The trousers have an {elastic} waist, so they fit everyone.
translation: У брюк эластичный пояс, поэтому они подходят всем.

definition: a clear explanation of an idea, or a large public exhibition
sentence: The first chapter is a clear {exposition} of the theory.
translation: Первая глава — ясное изложение теории.

definition: a strong unusual interest in something, often sexual
sentence: He has a {fetish} for tidy desks and sharpened pencils.
translation: У него пунктик на аккуратных столах и заточенных карандашах.

definition: soft and light, like fur or feathers
sentence: The {fluffy} kitten curled up in the basket.
translation: Пушистый котёнок свернулся в корзинке.

definition: made of straight lines, circles and regular shapes
sentence: The carpet has a bold {geometric} pattern in red and black.
translation: У ковра яркий геометрический узор в красно-чёрных тонах.

definition: polite, kind and generous, especially to people of lower rank
sentence: The champion was {gracious} in defeat and praised her opponent.
translation: Чемпионка достойно приняла поражение и похвалила соперницу.

definition: the quality of not thinking you are better than other people
sentence: Despite his fame, the actor spoke with real {humility}.
translation: Несмотря на славу, актёр говорил с искренней скромностью.

definition: the process of charging a senior official with a serious crime in office
sentence: The vote for {impeachment} of the president failed by ten votes.
translation: Голосование за импичмент президенту провалилось с разницей в десять голосов.

definition: as a natural and permanent part of something
sentence: Climbing is {inherently} risky, whatever equipment you use.
translation: Альпинизм опасен по своей природе, какое бы снаряжение ни использовать.

definition: wood that has been cut into boards for building, in American English
sentence: The truck carried a load of {lumber} to the building site.
translation: Грузовик вёз пиломатериалы на стройку.

definition: a polite way of speaking to a woman, especially a customer
sentence: 'Can I help you, {madam}?' asked the shop assistant.
translation: «Могу я вам помочь, мадам?» — спросила продавщица.

definition: relating to marriage
sentence: The form asks about your {marital} status: single, married or divorced.
translation: В анкете спрашивают о семейном положении: холост, женат или разведён.

definition: a very large number of people or things
sentence: A {multitude} of small boats filled the harbour for the festival.
translation: Множество маленьких лодок заполнило гавань на время фестиваля.

definition: a woman whose job is to look after a family's children in their home
sentence: The {nanny} takes the twins to the park every afternoon.
translation: Няня каждый день после обеда водит близнецов в парк.

definition: the number 19
sentence: He joined the navy at {nineteen} and saw the world.
translation: В девятнадцать он пошёл на флот и повидал мир.

definition: relating to the curved path of an object around a planet or star
sentence: The satellite completed its first {orbital} flight around Mars.
translation: Спутник совершил первый орбитальный полёт вокруг Марса.

definition: love for your country and pride in it
sentence: His {patriotism} showed in the flag he flew on every holiday.
translation: Его патриотизм проявлялся во флаге, который он вывешивал на каждый праздник.

definition: from time to time, at regular intervals
sentence: The nurse checked on him {periodically} through the night.
translation: Медсестра периодически проверяла его в течение ночи.

definition: the state of being prepared, or willingness to do something
sentence: The army was kept in a state of {readiness} all winter.
translation: Армию всю зиму держали в состоянии готовности.

definition: no longer needed, or having lost a job because the work no longer exists
sentence: Two hundred workers were made {redundant} when the plant closed.
translation: Двести рабочих были уволены по сокращению, когда завод закрылся.

definition: the fact of looking like or being similar to someone or something
sentence: There is a strong {resemblance} between the brothers.
translation: Между братьями сильное сходство.

definition: thin in an attractive way, or small in amount
sentence: The {slender} dancer moved like water across the stage.
translation: Стройная танцовщица двигалась по сцене, как вода.

definition: done without care, so it is not tidy
sentence: His {sloppy} handwriting made the letter hard to read.
translation: Из-за его небрежного почерка письмо было трудно прочитать.

definition: relating to society and the way it is organised
sentence: The report looks at the {societal} causes of crime.
translation: В отчёте рассматриваются общественные причины преступности.

definition: the state of being better or more powerful than others
sentence: The team's {superiority} showed in a five-goal win.
translation: Превосходство команды проявилось в победе с перевесом в пять голов.

definition: strange and dreamlike, not seeming real
sentence: It was {surreal} to see snow on the beach in July.
translation: Было сюрреалистично видеть снег на пляже в июле.

definition: a very strong storm with wind and rain in the western Pacific
sentence: The {typhoon} forced the airport to close for two days.
translation: Из-за тайфуна аэропорт закрылся на два дня.

definition: so strange or good that it seems not to be real
sentence: The silence after the storm felt {unreal}.
translation: Тишина после бури казалась нереальной.

definition: the period during which a country is fighting a war
sentence: In {wartime} the factory made guns instead of cars.
translation: В военное время завод делал оружие вместо машин.

definition: a mass of earth and rock falling down a slope, or a huge election victory
sentence: Heavy rain caused a {landslide} that blocked the mountain road.
translation: Сильный дождь вызвал оползень, перекрывший горную дорогу.

definition: a short funny or interesting story about a real person or event
sentence: The old captain had an {anecdote} for every port he had visited.
translation: У старого капитана была история про каждый порт, где он побывал.

definition: an area of soft wet ground
sentence: Keep to the path; the {bog} will swallow your boots.
translation: Держись тропы, болото засосёт твои сапоги.

definition: to officially take something away from someone as a punishment
sentence: The teacher will {confiscate} any phone used during the lesson.
translation: Учитель заберёт любой телефон, используемый во время урока.

definition: to talk with someone, in formal language
sentence: They would {converse} in French so the children could not understand.
translation: Они беседовали по-французски, чтобы дети не поняли.

definition: the degree to which a road or line slopes
sentence: The road has a steep {gradient} of one in five.
translation: У дороги крутой уклон, один к пяти.

definition: to officially charge someone with a serious crime
sentence: A jury voted to {indict} the mayor for taking bribes.
translation: Присяжные проголосовали за предъявление мэру обвинения во взяточничестве.

definition: a complaint that you have been treated badly
sentence: Staff can bring any {grievance} to the manager in writing.
translation: Сотрудники могут подать любую жалобу менеджеру в письменном виде.

definition: to persuade someone to have sex, or to attract them to do something
sentence: Low prices may {seduce} shoppers into buying things they do not need.
translation: Низкие цены могут соблазнить покупателей на ненужные покупки.

definition: to use your authority to reject a decision, or to take control from a system
sentence: The captain can {override} the automatic pilot at any time.
translation: Капитан может в любой момент отключить автопилот и взять управление.

definition: a person who fights hard for a cause, or a soldier in a religious war
sentence: She is a tireless {crusader} for cleaner rivers.
translation: Она неутомимый борец за чистоту рек.

definition: to organise people or resources for a purpose, or to prepare an army for war
sentence: The charity can {mobilize} a thousand volunteers in a day.
translation: Благотворительная организация может мобилизовать тысячу волонтёров за день.

definition: at the back, used about an animal's legs
sentence: The dog stood on its {hind} legs to reach the table.
translation: Собака встала на задние лапы, чтобы дотянуться до стола.

definition: something that comes before and leads to a later thing
sentence: The small tremor was a {precursor} of the earthquake.
translation: Небольшой толчок был предвестником землетрясения.

definition: to divide something into two equal parts, or to reduce it by half
sentence: The new road will {halve} the journey to the coast.
translation: Новая дорога сократит путь до побережья вдвое.

definition: to become or make smaller in amount or strength
sentence: Ice will {lessen} the swelling around the ankle.
translation: Лёд уменьшит отёк вокруг лодыжки.

definition: an area of land that is often covered with water, such as a marsh
sentence: The {wetland} is home to a hundred kinds of birds.
translation: В этих заболоченных землях живёт сотня видов птиц.

definition: a short appearance by a famous person in a film or play
sentence: The director makes a {cameo} as a waiter in every film.
translation: Режиссёр появляется в эпизодической роли официанта в каждом фильме.

definition: a unit of sound in a word, with one vowel sound
sentence: The word 'banana' has three {syllables}.
translation: В слове «banana» три слога.

definition: to choose and organise the objects in an exhibition or collection
sentence: She was asked to {curate} a show of young painters.
translation: Её попросили курировать выставку молодых художников.

definition: a list of questions that many people answer to give information
sentence: Every visitor was asked to fill in a short {questionnaire}.
translation: Каждого посетителя попросили заполнить короткую анкету.

definition: to imagine something that may happen in the future
sentence: The architects {envision} a park where the car factory now stands.
translation: Архитекторы представляют парк там, где сейчас стоит автозавод.

definition: to feed a baby with milk from the mother's breast
sentence: Doctors advise mothers to {breastfeed} for the first six months.
translation: Врачи советуют матерям кормить грудью первые шесть месяцев.

definition: any day of the week except Saturday and Sunday
sentence: The museum is quieter on a {weekday} than at the weekend.
translation: В будний день в музее тише, чем в выходные.

definition: to make someone decide not to do something, often by frightening them
sentence: Bright lights {deter} thieves from the car park at night.
translation: Яркое освещение отпугивает воров с парковки по ночам.

definition: a public show with people in costume, or a competition for beauty
sentence: The village holds a {pageant} every summer to tell its history.
translation: Каждое лето в деревне устраивают представление об её истории.

definition: to make something flat, or to knock it down
sentence: The storm will {flatten} the wheat if it comes before harvest.
translation: Если буря придёт до жатвы, она положит всю пшеницу.

definition: a religious leader in Islam who leads prayers in a mosque
sentence: The {imam} called the people to prayer at sunset.
translation: Имам призвал людей к молитве на закате.

definition: something you buy or keep to remember a place or event
sentence: She bought a small bell as a {souvenir} of the mountain village.
translation: Она купила маленький колокольчик на память о горной деревне.

definition: a place on a road or border where vehicles and people are checked
sentence: Soldiers at the {checkpoint} asked to see our passports.
translation: Солдаты на блокпосту попросили показать паспорта.

definition: to copy someone because you admire them, or to copy a system
sentence: Young players try to {emulate} the stars they see on television.
translation: Молодые игроки пытаются подражать звёздам, которых видят по телевизору.

definition: to make someone be quiet, or to become quiet
sentence: The teacher raised a hand to {hush} the class.
translation: Учительница подняла руку, чтобы утихомирить класс.

definition: relating to the part of the body between the chest and the hips
sentence: Sharp {abdominal} pain sent him straight to hospital.
translation: Резкая боль в животе отправила его прямо в больницу.

definition: the painted cloth at the back of a stage, or the setting of an event
sentence: The talks took place against a {backdrop} of rising prices.
translation: Переговоры проходили на фоне растущих цен.

definition: causing sudden great damage or suffering
sentence: The dam's failure was {catastrophic} for the valley below.
translation: Прорыв плотины стал катастрофой для долины внизу.

definition: black burnt wood used as fuel or for drawing
sentence: Light the {charcoal} half an hour before you start cooking.
translation: Разожги уголь за полчаса до начала готовки.

definition: of low quality and too sweet in feeling,
sentence: The film's {cheesy} ending made the audience groan.
translation: Слащавая концовка фильма заставила зрителей застонать.

definition: a fruit such as an orange or lemon, or the tree it grows on
sentence: The smell of {citrus} filled the kitchen as she peeled the oranges.
translation: Запах цитрусовых наполнил кухню, когда она чистила апельсины.

definition: the ability to do something well
sentence: Nobody doubts her {competence} as a surgeon.
translation: Никто не сомневается в её компетентности как хирурга.

definition: spreading from one person to another by touch or through the air
sentence: Measles is highly {contagious}, so keep the child at home.
translation: Корь очень заразна, так что держите ребёнка дома.

definition: in a way that is easy or suitable, or at a useful time
sentence: The hotel is {conveniently} close to the station.
translation: Отель удобно расположен рядом с вокзалом.

definition: the room in which a trial is held
sentence: The {courtroom} fell silent as the judge entered.
translation: В зале суда стало тихо, когда вошёл судья.

definition: behaving in an unusual way that others find strange
sentence: The {eccentric} professor cycled to work in a top hat.
translation: Эксцентричный профессор ездил на работу на велосипеде в цилиндре.

definition: relating to the combined effects of electricity and magnetism
sentence: Radio waves are part of the {electromagnetic} spectrum.
translation: Радиоволны — часть электромагнитного спектра.

definition: an extreme political system with a single leader, strong control and no opposition
sentence: The rise of {fascism} in the 1930s led to war.
translation: Подъём фашизма в 1930-е привёл к войне.

definition: frightened, or very bad
sentence: The {fearful} child hid behind her mother when the dog barked.
translation: Испуганный ребёнок спрятался за мать, когда залаяла собака.

definition: relating to a celebration, or cheerful and suited to one
sentence: The streets had a {festive} look with lights in every window.
translation: Улицы выглядели празднично, в каждом окне горели огни.

definition: a worker who is in charge of a group of other workers
sentence: The {foreman} checked every wall before the builders went home.
translation: Бригадир проверил каждую стену, прежде чем строители ушли домой.

definition: not suitable, not correct or not acceptable
sentence: It is {improper} to ask a guest how much they earn.
translation: Неприлично спрашивать гостя, сколько он зарабатывает.

definition: the arrival of a large number of people or things at the same time
sentence: The festival brings an {influx} of visitors every August.
translation: Фестиваль каждый август приносит наплыв посетителей.

definition: communication between groups that work together, or a person who does this
sentence: She acts as the {liaison} between the hospital and the families.
translation: Она служит связующим звеном между больницей и семьями.

definition: very poor, or wanting too much attention and love
sentence: The charity gives winter coats to {needy} families.
translation: Благотворительная организация раздаёт зимние пальто нуждающимся семьям.

definition: the study of light and how we see, or how a situation looks to people
sentence: She studied {optics} and now designs camera lenses.
translation: Она изучала оптику и теперь проектирует объективы для камер.

definition: a soft silver-white metal element found in plants and needed by the body
sentence: Bananas are full of {potassium}, which is good for the heart.
translation: Бананы богаты калием, полезным для сердца.

definition: so valuable that no price can be put on it
sentence: The museum holds a {priceless} collection of ancient coins.
translation: В музее хранится бесценная коллекция древних монет.

definition: thinking deeply and quietly, or able to reflect light
sentence: He was in a {reflective} mood after his father's funeral.
translation: После похорон отца он был в задумчивом настроении.

definition: the ability to recover quickly from difficulties or damage
sentence: The town showed great {resilience} after the flood.
translation: Город проявил большую стойкость после наводнения.

definition: a tool for cutting with two sharp blades joined in the middle
sentence: Hand me the {scissors} so I can cut the ribbon.
translation: Подай ножницы, я отрежу ленту.

definition: the area by the sea, especially where people go on holiday
sentence: We spent a week at the {seaside} every summer when I was small.
translation: Когда я был маленьким, мы каждое лето проводили неделю на море.

definition: a liquid soap used for washing hair
sentence: This {shampoo} smells of coconut and makes my hair shine.
translation: Этот шампунь пахнет кокосом и придаёт волосам блеск.

definition: without any sound, or without saying anything
sentence: The cat moved {silently} across the roof.
translation: Кошка бесшумно прошла по крыше.

definition: a dance from Argentina with quick dramatic steps, or its music
sentence: They learned the {tango} for their wedding dance.
translation: Они разучили танго для свадебного танца.

definition: accepting beliefs and behaviour that are different from your own
sentence: The city is {tolerant} of people from every background.
translation: Город терпимо относится к людям любого происхождения.

definition: the degree to which a substance is poisonous
sentence: Scientists tested the {toxicity} of the new paint on fish.
translation: Учёные проверили токсичность новой краски на рыбах.

definition: a serious infectious disease of the lungs
sentence: A century ago {tuberculosis} killed one person in seven.
translation: Век назад туберкулёз убивал каждого седьмого.

definition: in a way that shows you are happy to do something
sentence: She {willingly} gave up her seat for the old man.
translation: Она охотно уступила место старику.

definition: typical of young people, or seeming young
sentence: At sixty he still has a {youthful} energy.
translation: В шестьдесят у него всё ещё юношеская энергия.

definition: great danger, in formal or literary language
sentence: The sailors were in {peril} as the storm grew.
translation: Моряки были в опасности, когда шторм усилился.

definition: a person who leads the crowd in cheering at a game, or a strong supporter
sentence: As a {cheerleader} she practised every day after school.
translation: Как чирлидер, она тренировалась каждый день после школы.

definition: a person who thinks and acts independently and does not follow the rules
sentence: The {maverick} senator voted against his own party again.
translation: Сенатор-бунтарь снова проголосовал против собственной партии.

definition: a flat round piece of minced beef cooked and served in a bread roll
sentence: He ordered a {hamburger} with cheese and fries.
translation: Он заказал гамбургер с сыром и картошкой фри.

definition: paint put on a surface before the main coat, or a short book of basics
sentence: Put a coat of {primer} on the wood before you paint it.
translation: Нанеси грунтовку на дерево, прежде чем красить.

definition: calm confident control of your body and feelings
sentence: She answered the rude question with great {poise}.
translation: Она ответила на грубый вопрос с большим самообладанием.

definition: a man armed with a gun, especially a criminal
sentence: The {gunman} escaped on a motorbike after the robbery.
translation: Вооружённый преступник скрылся на мотоцикле после ограбления.

definition: a person employed to protect an important person
sentence: The president's {bodyguard} never left his side.
translation: Телохранитель президента не отходил от него ни на шаг.

definition: something used to fill a space, gap or time
sentence: Use wood {filler} to hide the holes before painting.
translation: Используй шпаклёвку по дереву, чтобы скрыть дыры перед покраской.

definition: a tiny particle in the centre of an atom with no electric charge
sentence: A {neutron} has almost the same mass as a proton.
translation: Нейтрон имеет почти такую же массу, как протон.

definition: to say in public that someone has done something well
sentence: The judge chose to {commend} the witness for her courage.
translation: Судья решила отметить свидетельницу за её мужество.

definition: to cut lines into glass or metal to make a picture or words
sentence: The jeweller will {etch} your initials on the ring.
translation: Ювелир выгравирует ваши инициалы на кольце.

definition: a short repeated series of notes in pop or jazz music
sentence: The song starts with a guitar {riff} everyone knows.
translation: Песня начинается с гитарного риффа, который знают все.

definition: a person who believes that there should be no government or laws
sentence: The {anarchist} refused to vote in any election.
translation: Анархист отказывался голосовать на любых выборах.

definition: not caring enough about something serious
sentence: The company took a {cavalier} attitude to safety.
translation: Компания относилась к безопасности пренебрежительно.

definition: great mental or physical suffering, or something that causes it
sentence: The noise from the road was a daily {torment}.
translation: Шум с дороги был ежедневной мукой.

definition: a fire that spreads quickly across a large area of countryside
sentence: The {wildfire} jumped the river and reached the village.
translation: Лесной пожар перекинулся через реку и добрался до деревни.

definition: a sound made with an open mouth, written as a, e, i, o or u
sentence: Every English word has at least one {vowel} sound.
translation: В каждом английском слове есть хотя бы один гласный звук.

definition: a famous female singer, or a woman who is difficult and demanding
sentence: The {diva} refused to sing until the flowers were changed.
translation: Дива отказалась петь, пока не заменят цветы.

definition: the way a person earns the money they need to live
sentence: Fishing is the {livelihood} of most families on the island.
translation: Рыбалка — средство к существованию для большинства семей на острове.

definition: a tiny particle in the centre of an atom with a positive electric charge
sentence: Hydrogen has a single {proton} at its centre.
translation: В центре атома водорода один протон.

definition: one of the joints where your fingers bend
sentence: He scraped a {knuckle} on the rough wall.
translation: Он ободрал костяшку пальца о шершавую стену.

definition: a large male cow used for pulling carts or ploughs
sentence: An {ox} pulled the heavy cart up the muddy track.
translation: Вол тянул тяжёлую телегу по грязной дороге.

definition: the repeating of a process, or one version of something that is repeated
sentence: The third {iteration} of the app finally fixed the login bug.
translation: Третья версия приложения наконец исправила ошибку входа.

definition: to make someone look stupid by laughing at them unkindly
sentence: The papers began to {ridicule} the minister's new haircut.
translation: Газеты стали высмеивать новую причёску министра.

definition: a person who buys something
sentence: The {purchaser} must pay within thirty days of the sale.
translation: Покупатель должен заплатить в течение тридцати дней после продажи.

definition: a period of learning a trade by working for a skilled person
sentence: He did a four-year {apprenticeship} with a master carpenter.
translation: Он четыре года учился у мастера-плотника.

definition: a frequent change in amount or level
sentence: Daily {fluctuations} in the price of oil worry the airlines.
translation: Ежедневные колебания цен на нефть беспокоят авиакомпании.

definition: a soldier who fights for any country or group that pays
sentence: The {mercenary} had fought in five wars on three continents.
translation: Наёмник воевал в пяти войнах на трёх континентах.

definition: to press a mark onto a surface, or to fix something firmly in the mind
sentence: The machine will {imprint} the date on every tin.
translation: Машина отпечатает дату на каждой банке.

definition: the headache and sickness you feel the day after drinking too much alcohol
sentence: He woke with a {hangover} and a vague memory of singing.
translation: Он проснулся с похмельем и смутным воспоминанием о том, как пел.

definition: meaning or saying yes
sentence: The answer to the second question was {affirmative}.
translation: Ответ на второй вопрос был утвердительным.

definition: having more than one possible meaning, not clear
sentence: His message was so {ambiguous} that I didn't know if he was coming.
translation: Его сообщение было таким двусмысленным, что я не понял, придёт ли он.

definition: the study of ancient people through their buildings, tools and bones
sentence: She studied {archaeology} and spent every summer digging in Greece.
translation: Она изучала археологию и каждое лето проводила на раскопках в Греции.

definition: an examination of a dead body to find out the cause of death
sentence: The {autopsy} showed that the man had drowned.
translation: Вскрытие показало, что мужчина утонул.

definition: a sudden short period of very hard work or attack
sentence: The council launched a cleaning {blitz} before the festival.
translation: Перед фестивалем совет устроил генеральную уборку города.

definition: the surrounding of a place to stop goods or people getting in or out
sentence: The naval {blockade} cut off the island's food supply.
translation: Морская блокада отрезала остров от поставок продовольствия.

definition: the quality of giving out or reflecting a lot of light
sentence: Turn down the {brightness} of the screen at night.
translation: Ночью уменьшай яркость экрана.

definition: a light perfume, especially one worn by men
sentence: He splashed on some {cologne} before the interview.
translation: Перед собеседованием он побрызгался одеколоном.

definition: the process of burning
sentence: An engine turns the heat of {combustion} into movement.
translation: Двигатель превращает тепло сгорания в движение.

definition: the ability to understand something
sentence: The test checks reading {comprehension} with ten questions.
translation: Тест проверяет понимание прочитанного десятью вопросами.

definition: a curved shape with two points, like the moon in its first week
sentence: A thin {crescent} of moon hung over the hills.
translation: Тонкий серп луны висел над холмами.

definition: not working properly or having a fault
sentence: The shop replaced the {defective} kettle without question.
translation: Магазин без вопросов заменил бракованный чайник.

definition: made to be thrown away after use
sentence: The cafe switched from {disposable} cups to glass ones.
translation: Кафе перешло с одноразовых стаканчиков на стеклянные.

definition: full of strong emotion, or burning or very hot
sentence: She gave a {fiery} speech against the closure of the school.
translation: Она произнесла пламенную речь против закрытия школы.

definition: a state of continuous change
sentence: The company's plans are in {flux} until the new owner arrives.
translation: Планы компании постоянно меняются, пока не прибудет новый владелец.

definition: the way a person writes with a pen or pencil
sentence: The doctor's {handwriting} was impossible to read.
translation: Почерк врача было невозможно разобрать.

definition: a situation that is annoying because it causes trouble or effort
sentence: Changing trains with three bags is a real {hassle}.
translation: Пересадка с тремя сумками — настоящая морока.

definition: causing great sadness
sentence: It was {heartbreaking} to see the old dog left at the shelter.
translation: Было больно смотреть, как старую собаку оставили в приюте.

definition: extremely or very much
sentence: The new library has been {immensely} popular with students.
translation: Новая библиотека пользуется огромной популярностью у студентов.

definition: a ceremony at which someone officially starts an important job
sentence: Thousands watched the {inauguration} of the new president.
translation: Тысячи людей смотрели инаугурацию нового президента.

definition: in a way that is wrong
sentence: The address was written {incorrectly}, so the parcel came back.
translation: Адрес был написан неправильно, и посылка вернулась.

definition: showing or suggesting something
sentence: Yellow leaves are {indicative} of too little water.
translation: Жёлтые листья указывают на нехватку воды.

definition: not costing much money
sentence: The hostel is {inexpensive} and clean, perfect for students.
translation: Хостел недорогой и чистый, идеально для студентов.

definition: based on feelings rather than facts, or easy to understand without instructions
sentence: The app is {intuitive}; my grandmother used it in five minutes.
translation: Приложение интуитивно понятное: бабушка освоила его за пять минут.

definition: happy and full of fun
sentence: The {jolly} baker sang while he worked.
translation: Весёлый пекарь пел за работой.

definition: very beautiful, impressive and grand
sentence: The {majestic} mountains rose behind the lake.
translation: Величественные горы поднимались за озером.

definition: great skill or complete knowledge of something
sentence: His {mastery} of the violin amazed the older players.
translation: Его виртуозное владение скрипкой поражало старших музыкантов.

definition: a very large and busy city
sentence: Tokyo is a {metropolis} of nearly forty million people.
translation: Токио — мегаполис с населением почти сорок миллионов.

definition: the study of diseases, or the signs of a disease
sentence: The sample was sent to {pathology} for testing.
translation: Образец отправили в патологоанатомическое отделение на анализ.

definition: containing poison, or able to kill or harm if eaten or touched
sentence: Those red berries are {poisonous}, so do not touch them.
translation: Эти красные ягоды ядовиты, не трогай их.

definition: the act of moving to a new place to live or work
sentence: The company pays the costs of {relocation} for new staff.
translation: Компания оплачивает расходы на переезд новым сотрудникам.

definition: a herb with thin needle-like leaves and a strong smell
sentence: Roast the potatoes with garlic and {rosemary}.
translation: Запеки картошку с чесноком и розмарином.

definition: a soft rock made of sand pressed together, used for building
sentence: The old church is built of yellow {sandstone}.
translation: Старая церковь построена из жёлтого песчаника.

definition: the systems for keeping places clean and removing waste
sentence: Poor {sanitation} spreads disease faster than anything.
translation: Плохие санитарные условия разносят болезни быстрее всего.

definition: good enough, though not excellent
sentence: Her work is {satisfactory}, but she could do better.
translation: Её работа удовлетворительна, но она могла бы лучше.

definition: the state of keeping something secret
sentence: The talks were held in complete {secrecy}.
translation: Переговоры проходили в полной тайне.

definition: so bad that people should feel ashamed
sentence: It is {shameful} that the old man waited six hours for a doctor.
translation: Позор, что старик ждал врача шесть часов.

definition: done without the agreement of the people in charge
sentence: {Unauthorized} people may not enter the control room.
translation: Посторонним вход в пункт управления воспрещён.

definition: whose name is not known or not given
sentence: An {unnamed} buyer paid a record price for the painting.
translation: Неназванный покупатель заплатил за картину рекордную цену.

definition: the liquid some snakes and insects use to hurt or kill
sentence: The snake's {venom} can kill a man in an hour.
translation: Яд этой змеи может убить человека за час.

definition: having won a game, battle or election
sentence: The {victorious} team rode through the city in an open bus.
translation: Команда-победитель проехала по городу в открытом автобусе.

definition: careful because you are worried about danger or problems
sentence: Be {wary} of emails that ask for your password.
translation: Опасайся писем, в которых просят ваш пароль.

definition: the state of being healthy in body and mind
sentence: The company runs a {wellness} programme with yoga at lunchtime.
translation: В компании есть программа здоровья с йогой в обед.

definition: with a lot of air moving fast outside
sentence: It was too {windy} to put up the tent.
translation: Было слишком ветрено, чтобы ставить палатку.

definition: a photograph taken quickly, or a short description of a situation at one moment
sentence: The report gives a {snapshot} of the city's traffic on one day.
translation: Отчёт даёт мгновенный срез городского движения за один день.

definition: a thin book with a paper cover that gives information or argues for an idea
sentence: The group handed out a {pamphlet} about the new road.
translation: Группа раздавала брошюру о новой дороге.

definition: a long narrow cut or opening
sentence: Light came through a {slit} in the curtains.
translation: Свет пробивался сквозь щель в шторах.

definition: to cause a feeling or interest in someone
sentence: The strange light in the sky began to {arouse} curiosity.
translation: Странный свет в небе начал вызывать любопытство.

definition: to praise something strongly in order to sell it or get support for it
sentence: The brochures {tout} the island as a paradise for divers.
translation: Буклеты расхваливают остров как рай для дайверов.

definition: to make people stop believing or respecting someone or something
sentence: The lawyer tried to {discredit} the witness by questioning her memory.
translation: Адвокат пытался дискредитировать свидетельницу, ставя под сомнение её память.

definition: a shop that sells books
sentence: The little {bookstore} on the corner closed after forty years.
translation: Маленький книжный магазин на углу закрылся спустя сорок лет.

definition: a word such as 'big' or 'red' that describes a noun
sentence: In 'a red car', the {adjective} is 'red'.
translation: В «a red car» прилагательное — «red».

definition: a light open shoe held on by straps
sentence: She wore a leather {sandal} on each foot and no socks.
translation: На ней были кожаные сандалии и никаких носков.

definition: a flat crisp cake with a pattern of squares, eaten with sweet toppings
sentence: She ordered a {waffle} with strawberries and cream.
translation: Она заказала вафлю с клубникой и сливками.

definition: a person who takes and gives out money at a bank
sentence: The {teller} counted the notes twice before handing them over.
translation: Кассир дважды пересчитал купюры, прежде чем выдать.

definition: a camera connected to a computer that sends pictures over the internet
sentence: Cover the {webcam} when you are not using it.
translation: Закрывай веб-камеру, когда ею не пользуешься.

definition: an imaginary creature with a woman's body and a fish's tail
sentence: The sailor swore he had seen a {mermaid} on the rocks.
translation: Моряк клялся, что видел русалку на скалах.

definition: to surprise or shock someone very much
sentence: The size of the cave will {astound} you.
translation: Размер пещеры вас поразит.

definition: a place where a bird rests, or a high seat, or a freshwater fish
sentence: The owl watched from its {perch} on the barn roof.
translation: Сова наблюдала со своего места на крыше амбара.

definition: the act of paying back money that you borrowed
sentence: The monthly {repayment} on the loan is three hundred euros.
translation: Ежемесячный платёж по кредиту — триста евро.

definition: a religious leader such as a priest or imam
sentence: The {cleric} called for calm after the attack.
translation: Священнослужитель призвал к спокойствию после нападения.

definition: a person who owns a large area of land
sentence: The {landowner} let the village use the field for the fair.
translation: Землевладелец разрешил деревне использовать поле для ярмарки.

definition: a quicker way of getting somewhere or doing something
sentence: Take the {shortcut} through the park to save ten minutes.
translation: Пройди коротким путём через парк, сэкономишь десять минут.

definition: a business that sells cars or other products for a particular maker
sentence: He bought the car at the {dealership} on the ring road.
translation: Он купил машину в автосалоне на кольцевой дороге.

definition: a small animal with long front teeth, such as a mouse or rat
sentence: A {rodent} had chewed through the cable in the attic.
translation: Какой-то грызун перегрыз кабель на чердаке.

definition: the unit for measuring the force of an electric current
sentence: A car battery gives twelve {volts}.
translation: Автомобильный аккумулятор даёт двенадцать вольт.

definition: a cheap place to stay with shared rooms, often for young travellers
sentence: We stayed in a {hostel} with eight beds in one room.
translation: Мы остановились в хостеле, где в одной комнате было восемь кроватей.

definition: a long green plant food with a lot of water, eaten cold in salad
sentence: Slice the {cucumber} thinly for the sandwiches.
translation: Нарежь огурец тонко для бутербродов.

definition: a small smooth stone found on a beach or in a river
sentence: She picked up a white {pebble} and put it in her pocket.
translation: Она подняла белый камешек и положила в карман.

definition: a person who studies ancient people through buildings and objects found in the ground
sentence: The {archaeologist} found a Roman coin in the field.
translation: Археолог нашёл в поле римскую монету.

definition: the person who makes sure the rules are followed in tennis, cricket or baseball
sentence: The {umpire} called the ball out and the crowd groaned.
translation: Судья объявил аут, и трибуны застонали.

definition: a substance put on soil to make plants grow better
sentence: The farmer spread {fertilizer} on the fields in spring.
translation: Весной фермер разбросал удобрение по полям.

definition: a pear-shaped fruit with dark green skin and soft pale green flesh
sentence: Mash the {avocado} with lime and salt for the toast.
translation: Разомни авокадо с лаймом и солью для тоста.

definition: a person or army that enters a country by force
sentence: The {invader} burned the crops as the army moved north.
translation: Захватчик сжигал посевы, продвигаясь на север.

definition: skin moved from one part of the body to another, or dishonest gain
sentence: The burns needed a skin {graft} from her leg.
translation: Ожоги потребовали пересадки кожи с её ноги.

definition: to make a feeling or effect stronger
sentence: The dark music will {heighten} the tension in the scene.
translation: Мрачная музыка усилит напряжение в сцене.

definition: to bite or pick at something with the beak, used of birds
sentence: The hens {peck} at the ground looking for seeds.
translation: Куры клюют землю в поисках зёрен.

definition: an experienced and respected political leader
sentence: The old {statesman} was asked to lead the peace talks.
translation: Старого государственного деятеля попросили возглавить мирные переговоры.

definition: to produce a deep full sound, or to have meaning for people
sentence: Her story will {resonate} with anyone who has lost a job.
translation: Её история найдёт отклик у любого, кто терял работу.

definition: a small wave on the surface of water, or a spreading effect
sentence: A {ripple} spread across the pond where the stone fell.
translation: По пруду разошлась рябь там, где упал камень.

definition: to move money gained illegally through banks so it seems legal, or to wash clothes
sentence: The gang used the casino to {launder} the drug money.
translation: Банда отмывала деньги от наркотиков через казино.

definition: a tiny particle of light
sentence: A single {photon} is enough to trigger the sensor.
translation: Одного фотона достаточно, чтобы сработал датчик.

definition: to make a sound louder or a signal stronger, or to make something greater
sentence: The speakers {amplify} the singer's voice across the whole park.
translation: Колонки усиливают голос певицы на весь парк.

definition: a person trained to prepare and sell medicines
sentence: Ask the {pharmacist} whether the two medicines can be taken together.
translation: Спроси фармацевта, можно ли принимать эти два лекарства вместе.

definition: the outer shape of something, or a map line joining points of equal height
sentence: The {contour} lines on the map show how steep the hill is.
translation: Линии высот на карте показывают, насколько крут холм.

definition: a person who enters a place without permission
sentence: The dog barked and the {intruder} ran back over the fence.
translation: Собака залаяла, и незваный гость перемахнул обратно через забор.

definition: a building where Jewish people meet to pray
sentence: The {synagogue} on the hill is the oldest in the city.
translation: Синагога на холме — старейшая в городе.

definition: the part of the body between the chest and the hips that holds the stomach
sentence: The doctor pressed gently on her {abdomen} to find the pain.
translation: Врач осторожно надавил ей на живот, чтобы найти источник боли.

definition: very quickly and without any sign that it was coming
sentence: The bus stopped so {abruptly} that I dropped my coffee.
translation: Автобус затормозил так резко, что я уронил кофе.

definition: the time when someone usually goes to bed
sentence: The children's {bedtime} is eight o'clock on school nights.
translation: Дети ложатся спать в восемь, когда назавтра в школу.

definition: in a quiet, relaxed way without worry
sentence: She {calmly} explained that the fire was already out.
translation: Она спокойно объяснила, что огонь уже потушен.

definition: the state of being kept in a place and not free, used of animals
sentence: Pandas rarely have babies in {captivity}.
translation: Панды редко рожают в неволе.

definition: the treatment of cancer with strong drugs
sentence: She lost her hair during {chemotherapy} but it grew back.
translation: Во время химиотерапии она потеряла волосы, но они отросли.

definition: going well together because each adds something the other lacks
sentence: The two chefs have {complementary} skills: one bakes, one grills.
translation: У двух поваров взаимодополняющие навыки: один печёт, другой жарит.

definition: the ability of computers or phones to connect to the internet or each other
sentence: Mobile {connectivity} in the valley is poor, so download the map first.
translation: Мобильная связь в долине плохая, так что скачай карту заранее.

definition: the office of a consul in a foreign city
sentence: The {consulate} replaced her stolen passport in two days.
translation: Консульство заменило её украденный паспорт за два дня.

definition: relating to cooking
sentence: The town is famous for its {culinary} festival every October.
translation: Город славится своим кулинарным фестивалем каждый октябрь.

definition: separate and clearly different from others
sentence: The project is divided into five {discrete} stages.
translation: Проект разделён на пять отдельных этапов.

definition: famous and respected in a particular field
sentence: An {eminent} surgeon will give the opening lecture.
translation: Выдающийся хирург прочитает первую лекцию.

definition: the process of turning information into a code so others cannot read it
sentence: The app uses {encryption} so only the two of you can read the messages.
translation: Приложение использует шифрование, чтобы сообщения могли читать только вы двое.

definition: covered with fur, or feeling like fur
sentence: The {furry} little dog slept on her lap all evening.
translation: Пушистая собачка весь вечер спала у неё на коленях.

definition: an area of land, often by a church, where dead people are buried
sentence: The old {graveyard} behind the church has stones from the 1600s.
translation: На старом кладбище за церковью есть надгробия 1600-х годов.

definition: not based on reason or clear thinking
sentence: She has an {irrational} fear of birds.
translation: У неё иррациональный страх перед птицами.

definition: a plant with large green leaves eaten raw in salads
sentence: Wash the {lettuce} and tear the leaves into the bowl.
translation: Помой салат и порви листья в миску.

definition: a soft light metal used in batteries and some medicines
sentence: The phone's {lithium} battery lasts two days.
translation: Литиевая батарея телефона держит два дня.

definition: producing a lot of money
sentence: She left teaching for a more {lucrative} job in banking.
translation: Она ушла из преподавания на более прибыльную работу в банке.

definition: relating to the work of a manager
sentence: The job needs {managerial} experience and a cool head.
translation: Для этой работы нужны управленческий опыт и холодная голова.

definition: to an average degree, not very much
sentence: The restaurant is {moderately} priced and always full.
translation: Ресторан с умеренными ценами и всегда полон.

definition: the use of sound, pictures and video together, especially on computers
sentence: The museum uses {multimedia} to bring the old battle to life.
translation: Музей использует мультимедиа, чтобы оживить старую битву.

definition: a place in a desert with water and trees, or a pleasant place among bad
sentence: The travellers rested at an {oasis} before crossing the dunes.
translation: Путники отдохнули в оазисе, прежде чем пересечь дюны.

definition: in a strange or surprising way
sentence: {Oddly}, the dog refused to go into the new house.
translation: Странно, но собака отказалась заходить в новый дом.

definition: the outer parts of a town or city, far from the centre
sentence: They bought a house on the {outskirts}, where the land is cheaper.
translation: Они купили дом на окраине, где земля дешевле.

definition: relating to planets
sentence: The probe studied the {planetary} rings of Saturn for a decade.
translation: Зонд десять лет изучал планетарные кольца Сатурна.

definition: a hard white shiny material used for making cups, plates and figures
sentence: The {porcelain} cup was so thin you could see light through it.
translation: Фарфоровая чашка была такой тонкой, что просвечивала.

definition: the branch of medicine that treats mental illness
sentence: After medical school she chose {psychiatry} as her specialty.
translation: После медицинского факультета она выбрала психиатрию своей специальностью.

definition: involving the same thing done many times in a boring way
sentence: Packing boxes all day is {repetitive} but not hard.
translation: Паковать коробки целый день однообразно, но несложно.

definition: a change to the opposite direction, order or decision
sentence: The court's {reversal} of its earlier ruling surprised everyone.
translation: Отмена судом своего прежнего решения удивила всех.

definition: having practical knowledge and good judgement
sentence: {Savvy} shoppers wait for the January sales.
translation: Сообразительные покупатели ждут январских распродаж.

definition: a serious mental illness in which a person's thoughts and feelings are separated from reality
sentence: Her brother was diagnosed with {schizophrenia} at twenty-two.
translation: Её брату поставили диагноз шизофрения в двадцать два года.

definition: the quality of being serious or important
sentence: The doctor's face showed the {seriousness} of the injury.
translation: Лицо врача говорило о серьёзности травмы.

definition: a short period of doing a lot of one activity, such as spending
sentence: After payday she went on a shopping {spree}.
translation: После зарплаты она отправилась за покупками и накупила кучу всего.

definition: only on the surface, or not deep or serious
sentence: The cut was {superficial} and healed in a week.
translation: Порез был поверхностным и зажил за неделю.

definition: towards the place where a river starts, against the flow
sentence: The salmon swim {upstream} every autumn to lay their eggs.
translation: Каждую осень лосось плывёт вверх по течению, чтобы отложить икру.

definition: the part of a town next to the sea, a lake or a river
sentence: Cafes and galleries have opened all along the {waterfront}.
translation: Вдоль набережной открылись кафе и галереи.

definition: clever and funny in what you say
sentence: Her {witty} reply made the whole table laugh.
translation: Её остроумный ответ рассмешил весь стол.

definition: to send someone away from a place as a punishment
sentence: The king decided to {banish} the poet from the city.
translation: Король решил изгнать поэта из города.

definition: a member of a small unofficial army that fights by surprise attacks
sentence: The {guerrilla} group hid in the mountains and attacked at night.
translation: Партизанский отряд скрывался в горах и нападал по ночам.

definition: to stop someone taking part in a competition because they broke a rule
sentence: The judges had to {disqualify} the runner for a false start.
translation: Судьям пришлось дисквалифицировать бегуна за фальстарт.

definition: a person who behaves in a crazy or very foolish way
sentence: Some {lunatic} was driving at twice the speed limit in the fog.
translation: Какой-то сумасшедший ехал в туман вдвое быстрее разрешённой скорости.

definition: the act of doing or saying the same thing again
sentence: Learning a language needs a lot of {repetition}.
translation: Для изучения языка нужно много повторений.

definition: something that is very popular for a short time
sentence: The dance {craze} swept through every school in the country.
translation: Танцевальное поветрие охватило все школы страны.

definition: a person who rides waves on a board, or who looks at websites
sentence: The {surfer} waited an hour for the perfect wave.
translation: Сёрфер час ждал идеальную волну.

definition: a very small living thing that causes disease
sentence: The new {pathogen} spread through the hospital in a week.
translation: Новый возбудитель распространился по больнице за неделю.

definition: to be successful and become rich
sentence: Small shops {prosper} when the big stores close early.
translation: Маленькие магазины процветают, когда большие закрываются рано.

definition: to make something sharp, or to make a skill or feeling stronger
sentence: {Sharpen} the knife before you cut the meat.
translation: Наточи нож, прежде чем резать мясо.

definition: to get rid of something completely, especially a disease or problem
sentence: Vaccines helped to {eradicate} smallpox from the world.
translation: Вакцины помогли полностью искоренить оспу в мире.

definition: to make someone feel worried or uncertain
sentence: The noises in the night began to {unsettle} the children.
translation: Ночные шумы стали тревожить детей.

definition: something that stops an activity for a short time
sentence: The meeting went on for two hours without an {interruption}.
translation: Собрание длилось два часа без единого перерыва.

definition: a collection of poems or stories by different writers in one book
sentence: The {anthology} includes poems from twenty countries.
translation: В антологию вошли стихи из двадцати стран.

definition: a tall evergreen tree with needle-like leaves, often used as a Christmas tree
sentence: A tall {fir} stood in the square covered in lights.
translation: На площади стояла высокая ель, увешанная огнями.

definition: to wash something quickly in clean water to remove soap or dirt
sentence: {Rinse} the rice until the water runs clear.
translation: Промывай рис, пока вода не станет прозрачной.

definition: a difference from what is usual or expected
sentence: Any {deviation} from the recipe changes the taste of the bread.
translation: Любое отклонение от рецепта меняет вкус хлеба.

definition: to walk with difficulty because one leg or foot is hurt
sentence: The dog began to {limp} after it stepped on the glass.
translation: Собака захромала после того, как наступила на стекло.

definition: to pull or twist something suddenly and violently
sentence: He had to {wrench} the door open against the wind.
translation: Ему пришлось рывком открыть дверь против ветра.

definition: a person who makes things skilfully by hand
sentence: Every chair in the shop was made by a local {artisan}.
translation: Каждый стул в магазине сделан местным ремесленником.

definition: a person who sleeps in a tent on holiday, or a vehicle with beds
sentence: Every {camper} must put out their fire by midnight.
translation: Каждый турист обязан погасить костёр до полуночи.

definition: not allowed to be done or talked about because of social or religious rules
sentence: In her family, money was a {taboo} subject at dinner.
translation: В её семье деньги были запретной темой за ужином.

definition: a book or film that is very successful
sentence: The summer {blockbuster} earned a billion dollars in a month.
translation: Летний блокбастер заработал миллиард долларов за месяц.

definition: a person who leads a discussion and makes sure people follow the rules
sentence: The {moderator} gave each candidate two minutes to answer.
translation: Ведущий дал каждому кандидату по две минуты на ответ.

definition: a wide road with several lanes for fast travel between cities
sentence: Take the {motorway} north and leave at junction twelve.
translation: Поезжай по автомагистрали на север и съезжай на двенадцатой развязке.

definition: to pull something quickly, such as fruit, feathers or a string
sentence: She stopped to {pluck} an apple from the tree.
translation: Она остановилась, чтобы сорвать яблоко с дерева.

definition: a false name used by a criminal or a writer
sentence: The thief travelled under an {alias} for ten years.
translation: Вор десять лет путешествовал под вымышленным именем.

definition: to show that someone was involved in a crime
sentence: The letters {implicate} the mayor in the sale of the land.
translation: Письма указывают на причастность мэра к продаже земли.

definition: to push too much into a small space, or to study hard before a test
sentence: Students {cram} all night before the exam and forget it all after.
translation: Студенты зубрят всю ночь перед экзаменом и потом всё забывают.

definition: to use something again instead of throwing it away
sentence: We {reuse} the glass jars for jam every summer.
translation: Каждое лето мы снова используем стеклянные банки для варенья.

definition: to feel angry about something because it seems unfair
sentence: Older staff {resent} taking orders from a boss half their age.
translation: Старшим сотрудникам обидно получать приказы от начальника вдвое моложе их.

definition: an enemy or opponent in a fight or competition
sentence: The chess champion faced his old {adversary} in the final.
translation: Чемпион по шахматам встретился в финале со старым соперником.

definition: a violin, especially one used for folk music
sentence: He played the {fiddle} at every village dance.
translation: Он играл на скрипке на всех деревенских танцах.

definition: a large amount of water moving very fast, or a great flow of words
sentence: After the storm the quiet stream became a {torrent}.
translation: После бури тихий ручей превратился в бурный поток.

definition: a person who has diabetes, a disease with too much sugar in the blood
sentence: As a {diabetic}, she checks her blood sugar before every meal.
translation: Как диабетик, она проверяет сахар в крови перед каждым приёмом пищи.

definition: to give someone the responsibility for something valuable
sentence: I would not {entrust} my car to a driver I had never met.
translation: Я бы не доверил свою машину водителю, которого никогда не видел.

definition: to look secretly into someone's private things or business
sentence: Do not {snoop} in my drawers while I am away.
translation: Не рыскай в моих ящиках, пока меня нет.

definition: to decide which things are most important and do them first
sentence: With so little time, you must {prioritize} the urgent repairs.
translation: Когда времени мало, нужно расставить приоритеты и начать со срочного ремонта.

definition: to kill someone by pressing their throat so they cannot breathe
sentence: The vine grew so thick it began to {strangle} the young tree.
translation: Лоза так разрослась, что стала душить молодое дерево.

definition: to make an angry or worried expression by pulling your eyebrows together
sentence: The teacher began to {frown} as she read the essay.
translation: Учительница нахмурилась, читая сочинение.

definition: an exam in the middle of a school or college term
sentence: She stayed up all night studying for the chemistry {midterm}.
translation: Она всю ночь готовилась к промежуточному экзамену по химии.

definition: an amount of money paid back to you because you paid too much
sentence: The energy company sent a {rebate} of fifty pounds.
translation: Энергетическая компания вернула пятьдесят фунтов.

definition: the unit of money used in India and some other countries
sentence: The meal cost three hundred {rupees} for both of us.
translation: Обед стоил триста рупий на двоих.

definition: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves for storing things
sentence: The cups are in the {cupboard} above the sink.
translation: Чашки в шкафчике над раковиной.

definition: the belief that you are better or more important than other people
sentence: His {arrogance} cost him every friend he had.
translation: Его высокомерие стоило ему всех друзей.

definition: a person who goes to a meeting, conference or event
sentence: Every {attendee} received a badge and a programme.
translation: Каждый участник получил бейдж и программу.

definition: a Christian ceremony in which water is poured on a person to join the church
sentence: The whole family came to the baby's {baptism}.
translation: Вся семья пришла на крестины малыша.

definition: having pale yellow hair
sentence: The {blond} boy in the photo is my cousin.
translation: Светловолосый мальчик на фото — мой двоюродный брат.

definition: a system of rules and officials that makes things slow and complicated
sentence: It took months of {bureaucracy} to get the building permit.
translation: Получение разрешения на строительство заняло месяцы бюрократии.

definition: a large round vegetable with thick green or purple leaves
sentence: Boil the {cabbage} for five minutes and add butter.
translation: Вари капусту пять минут и добавь масло.

definition: with grey or white covering the sky, or not clear
sentence: It was {cloudy} all morning, but the sun came out at noon.
translation: Всё утро было пасмурно, но в полдень выглянуло солнце.

definition: feeling or showing sympathy for people who are suffering
sentence: The {compassionate} nurse sat with the old man until he slept.
translation: Сострадательная медсестра сидела со стариком, пока он не уснул.

definition: a car with a roof that can be folded back or removed
sentence: He drove the {convertible} along the coast with the roof down.
translation: Он ехал на кабриолете вдоль побережья с опущенной крышей.

definition: increasing by one addition after another
sentence: The {cumulative} effect of small savings is surprising after ten years.
translation: Накопительный эффект маленьких сбережений через десять лет удивляет.

definition: the feeling of having no hope and being ready to do anything
sentence: In {desperation}, he sold his watch to pay the rent.
translation: В отчаянии он продал часы, чтобы заплатить за жильё.

definition: causing harm or damage
sentence: Too much screen time is {detrimental} to children's sleep.
translation: Слишком много времени у экрана вредит детскому сну.

definition: an illness in which waste leaves the body as liquid too often
sentence: The dirty water gave half the camp {diarrhea}.
translation: Грязная вода вызвала диарею у половины лагеря.

definition: relating to the highest university degree
sentence: She finished her {doctoral} research on bees in four years.
translation: Она завершила докторское исследование о пчёлах за четыре года.

definition: not afraid of anything
sentence: The {fearless} climber went up the wall without a rope.
translation: Бесстрашный альпинист поднялся по стене без верёвки.

definition: a small bird with a short strong beak for eating seeds
sentence: A {finch} sang from the top of the apple tree.
translation: Зяблик пел на верхушке яблони.

definition: to do what you promised or what was expected
sentence: The hotel didn't {fulfil} any of its promises about the pool.
translation: Отель не выполнил ни одного обещания насчёт бассейна.

definition: a pause before doing or saying something because you are not sure
sentence: After a moment's {hesitation}, she signed the contract.
translation: После секундного колебания она подписала договор.

definition: the feeling of being made to look stupid or ashamed in front of others
sentence: Losing six-nil at home was a {humiliation} for the club.
translation: Поражение дома со счётом 0:6 стало унижением для клуба.

definition: annoyed because you have to wait, or eager to do something
sentence: The {impatient} driver sounded his horn at the red light.
translation: Нетерпеливый водитель сигналил на красный свет.

definition: having many small parts or details arranged in a complicated way
sentence: The carpet has an {intricate} pattern of flowers and birds.
translation: На ковре замысловатый узор из цветов и птиц.

definition: a Japanese sport of fighting with the hands and feet without weapons
sentence: She has a black belt in {karate}.
translation: У неё чёрный пояс по карате.

definition: long life, or the ability to last a long time
sentence: The village is known for the {longevity} of its people.
translation: Деревня известна долголетием своих жителей.

definition: traditional knowledge and stories about a subject
sentence: Local {lore} says a dragon sleeps under the hill.
translation: По местным преданиям, под холмом спит дракон.

definition: growing thickly and healthily, used about plants
sentence: After the rains the valley was {lush} and green.
translation: После дождей долина стала пышной и зелёной.

definition: very comfortable and expensive
sentence: They spent the night in a {luxurious} hotel by the lake.
translation: Они провели ночь в роскошном отеле у озера.

definition: a serious accident in a nuclear reactor, or a sudden loss of control
sentence: The toddler had a {meltdown} in the middle of the supermarket.
translation: У малыша случилась истерика посреди супермаркета.

definition: relating to a government minister
sentence: A {ministerial} car waited outside the parliament.
translation: У парламента ждала министерская машина.

definition: relating to spiritual truths beyond ordinary understanding
sentence: Pilgrims speak of the {mystical} power of the old spring.
translation: Паломники говорят о мистической силе старого источника.

definition: a long journey full of adventures and difficulties
sentence: Their {odyssey} across Africa took eighteen months.
translation: Их одиссея через Африку заняла полтора года.

definition: relating to the form of a word used for more than one thing
sentence: 'Children' is the {plural} form of 'child'.
translation: «Children» — форма множественного числа от «child».

definition: spreading or growing quickly in an uncontrolled way
sentence: Crime was {rampant} in the city after the police strike.
translation: После забастовки полиции преступность в городе разгулялась.

definition: an action taken to harm someone because they harmed you first
sentence: The attack on the village was {retaliation} for the raid.
translation: Нападение на деревню было ответом на набег.

definition: waste water and human waste carried away in pipes under the ground
sentence: Untreated {sewage} flowed into the river after the storm.
translation: После шторма неочищенные сточные воды потекли в реку.

definition: the quality of being concerned with the human spirit rather than material things
sentence: Her {spirituality} shows in the quiet hour she keeps every morning.
translation: Её духовность проявляется в тихом часе, который она выделяет каждое утро.

definition: a place where people drank beer and wine in the past, like a pub
sentence: The travellers stopped at a {tavern} for bread and ale.
translation: Путники остановились в таверне поесть хлеба и выпить эля.

definition: a message sent along wires and delivered in print, used in the past
sentence: A {telegram} arrived saying the ship had sunk.
translation: Пришла телеграмма с сообщением, что корабль затонул.

definition: a strong light silver metal used in planes and medical implants
sentence: The new bike frame is made of {titanium} and weighs almost nothing.
translation: Новая рама велосипеда из титана и почти ничего не весит.

definition: sudden violent movements of air that shake a plane, or a state of confusion
sentence: The plane hit {turbulence} and the coffee flew off the table.
translation: Самолёт попал в зону турбулентности, и кофе слетел со столика.

definition: not level or smooth, or not equal
sentence: The {uneven} floor made the table rock.
translation: Из-за неровного пола стол качался.

definition: the need for something to be done very quickly
sentence: There was {urgency} in her voice when she called for help.
translation: В её голосе звучала срочность, когда она звала на помощь.

definition: not letting water through
sentence: Take a {waterproof} jacket; the mountain weather changes fast.
translation: Возьми непромокаемую куртку, в горах погода меняется быстро.

definition: extremely well, or in a way that gives great pleasure
sentence: The old house is {wonderfully} quiet at night.
translation: Ночью в старом доме восхитительно тихо.

definition: a small thin book with pictures that gives information about a product or place
sentence: The travel {brochure} made the hotel look twice its size.
translation: В рекламном буклете отель выглядел вдвое больше.

definition: a soft comfortable shoe worn inside the house
sentence: She put on a {slipper} and went down to make tea.
translation: Она надела тапочки и спустилась заварить чай.

definition: a snake, especially a large one, in stories and old language
sentence: In the story a {serpent} guards the golden apples.
translation: В сказке змей охраняет золотые яблоки.

definition: a person trained to give medical help in an ambulance before the patient reaches hospital
sentence: The {paramedic} stopped the bleeding on the way to hospital.
translation: Фельдшер остановил кровотечение по дороге в больницу.

definition: courage and determination, or small pieces of stone or sand
sentence: It took real {grit} to finish the race with a hurt knee.
translation: Понадобилась настоящая стойкость, чтобы закончить забег с больным коленом.

definition: to give water to a person or thing, or to drink enough water
sentence: Runners must {hydrate} well before a long race.
translation: Бегунам нужно хорошо напиться воды перед долгим забегом.

definition: a group of people with something in common, such as age, studied together
sentence: The study followed a {cohort} of a thousand babies born in 1990.
translation: Исследование наблюдало группу из тысячи детей, рождённых в 1990 году.

definition: sounding low and rough, used about a voice
sentence: Her {husky} voice was the result of a long cold.
translation: Её хриплый голос был следствием долгой простуды.

definition: a person who works with others on a project, or who helps an enemy
sentence: Her main {collaborator} on the book was a historian from Oslo.
translation: Её главным соавтором книги был историк из Осло.

definition: a smooth brown nut that can be eaten roasted, or the tree it grows on
sentence: We roasted a {chestnut} on the fire and burnt our fingers.
translation: Мы жарили каштан на огне и обожгли пальцы.

definition: the line of people in a family from whom you are descended
sentence: The horse comes from a {lineage} of racing champions.
translation: Лошадь происходит из рода скаковых чемпионов.

definition: a tube wide at the top and narrow at the bottom, used for pouring liquid
sentence: Use a {funnel} to pour the oil into the bottle.
translation: Используй воронку, чтобы налить масло в бутылку.

definition: a thin stick used by a magician or in fairy tales to do magic
sentence: The fairy waved her {wand} and the pumpkin became a coach.
translation: Фея взмахнула палочкой, и тыква превратилась в карету.

definition: a room with a toilet in a public building, in American English
sentence: Excuse me, where is the {restroom}?
translation: Простите, где здесь туалет?

definition: a device that changes something from one form to another, such as electricity
sentence: The {converter} turns the sun's energy into power for the house.
translation: Преобразователь превращает энергию солнца в электричество для дома.

definition: the act of using one person or thing instead of another
sentence: The coach made a {substitution} in the last ten minutes.
translation: Тренер сделал замену в последние десять минут.

definition: a small amount of a colour, or a pale shade of it
sentence: The walls are white with a slight {tint} of blue.
translation: Стены белые с лёгким голубым оттенком.

definition: a place that is strongly defended, or where a belief is strong
sentence: The village was a {stronghold} of the old religion for centuries.
translation: Деревня веками была оплотом старой религии.

definition: an animal with brown fur and a long tail that swims and eats fish
sentence: An {otter} slid down the bank into the river.
translation: Выдра скользнула с берега в реку.

definition: to move smoothly and quietly, often through the air or over water
sentence: The swans {glide} across the lake without a sound.
translation: Лебеди бесшумно скользят по озеру.

definition: an official order to appear in court as a witness
sentence: The journalist received a {subpoena} to give evidence at the trial.
translation: Журналист получил повестку для дачи показаний на суде.

definition: to learn something so well that you can repeat it from memory
sentence: Actors have to {memorize} pages of lines in a few days.
translation: Актёрам приходится заучивать страницы текста за несколько дней.

definition: to make a statement about a whole group based on a few examples
sentence: You cannot {generalize} about a country after one weekend there.
translation: Нельзя делать выводы о целой стране после одних выходных.

definition: a machine that shows pictures or films on a wall or screen
sentence: The {projector} broke halfway through the lecture.
translation: Проектор сломался посреди лекции.

definition: a whole number such as 3 or 10, not a fraction
sentence: Every {integer} can be written as a sum of four squares.
translation: Любое целое число можно записать как сумму четырёх квадратов.

definition: a person who draws pictures for books, magazines or advertisements
sentence: The {illustrator} drew every animal in the children's book.
translation: Иллюстратор нарисовал всех животных в детской книге.

definition: a difference between two things that should be the same
sentence: There is a {discrepancy} between the receipt and the amount charged.
translation: Между чеком и списанной суммой есть расхождение.

definition: to give something out to people, or to prepare and give medicine
sentence: The machine will {dispense} a ticket when you press the button.
translation: Автомат выдаст билет, когда вы нажмёте кнопку.

definition: to become dry and die, used about plants, or to become weaker
sentence: Without rain the flowers will {wither} in a week.
translation: Без дождя цветы засохнут за неделю.

definition: to bring someone or something under control, often by force
sentence: It took four officers to {subdue} the angry man.
translation: Чтобы усмирить разъярённого мужчину, понадобились четверо полицейских.

definition: the player who hits the ball in cricket
sentence: The {batsman} scored a hundred runs before lunch.
translation: Отбивающий набрал сто очков до обеда.

definition: the person or thing responsible for a crime or problem
sentence: The {culprit} behind the broken window was the neighbour's cat.
translation: Виновником разбитого окна оказался соседский кот.

definition: a priest who works in a hospital, prison, school or army unit
sentence: The hospital {chaplain} visits every ward on Sunday.
translation: Больничный священник обходит все палаты по воскресеньям.

definition: to make a place stronger against attack, or to make food or a person stronger
sentence: The town began to {fortify} its walls as the army approached.
translation: Город стал укреплять стены, когда армия приблизилась.

definition: a small bag, or a pocket of skin in which some animals carry their young
sentence: The baby kangaroo sleeps in its mother's {pouch}.
translation: Детёныш кенгуру спит в сумке матери.

definition: to make something continue, especially something bad
sentence: Such films {perpetuate} the old idea that scientists are strange.
translation: Такие фильмы увековечивают старое представление о странных учёных.

definition: to obtain something, especially with effort or difficulty
sentence: The museum managed to {procure} the letter at auction.
translation: Музею удалось раздобыть письмо на аукционе.

definition: to make something return to a normal state, or to make it seem normal
sentence: The two countries hope to {normalize} relations by spring.
translation: Две страны надеются нормализовать отношения к весне.

definition: a place to stay for a short time, especially a rented room
sentence: The price includes food and {lodging} for three nights.
translation: В цену входят питание и проживание на три ночи.

definition: the quality of not being the same each time, or of two things not matching
sentence: The {inconsistency} between the two reports worried the judge.
translation: Расхождение между двумя отчётами встревожило судью.

definition: a substance in foods such as bread and rice that gives the body energy
sentence: Runners eat a lot of {carbohydrate} the night before a race.
translation: Бегуны едят много углеводов вечером перед забегом.

definition: to encourage people to do something violent or illegal
sentence: He was arrested for trying to {incite} a riot.
translation: Его арестовали за попытку подстрекательства к беспорядкам.

definition: a small electric light you carry in your hand, in American English
sentence: Keep a {flashlight} by the bed in case the power fails.
translation: Держи фонарик у кровати на случай отключения света.

definition: a person who moves on ice or on a board with wheels
sentence: The young {skater} landed every jump in the final.
translation: Юная фигуристка приземлила все прыжки в финале.

definition: to give someone back their job or position, or to bring back a rule
sentence: The court ordered the company to {reinstate} the sacked driver.
translation: Суд обязал компанию восстановить уволенного водителя на работе.

definition: the world of universities and research
sentence: After ten years in {academia}, she moved to a software company.
translation: После десяти лет в академической среде она перешла в софтверную компанию.

definition: official approval that a school, course or organisation meets a standard
sentence: The college lost its {accreditation} after the inspection.
translation: После проверки колледж лишился аккредитации.

definition: used to agree that something is true, often before making a different point
sentence: {Admittedly}, the hotel was cheap, but the beds were awful.
translation: Признаю, отель был дешёвым, но кровати ужасные.

definition: a grey material once used in buildings that causes lung disease
sentence: Workers found {asbestos} in the roof and stopped the repairs.
translation: Рабочие нашли в крыше асбест и остановили ремонт.

definition: the act of keeping away from something or not doing it
