sentence: Tax {avoidance} is legal; tax evasion is not.
translation: Уклонение от налогов законными способами разрешено, незаконное — нет.

definition: a meal where guests serve themselves from a table of dishes
sentence: The hotel breakfast is a {buffet} with eggs, fruit and cheese.
translation: Завтрак в отеле — шведский стол с яйцами, фруктами и сыром.

definition: the frame of a vehicle on which the body and engine are fixed
sentence: The {chassis} of the old truck was still solid under the rust.
translation: Рама старого грузовика под ржавчиной была всё ещё крепкой.

definition: an explanation that makes something clearer
sentence: We asked the bank for {clarification} of the new fees.
translation: Мы попросили банк разъяснить новые комиссии.

definition: something that makes you feel better when you are sad or disappointed
sentence: The only {consolation} after the defeat was the fans' applause.
translation: Единственным утешением после поражения были аплодисменты болельщиков.

definition: done secretly
sentence: The police ran a {covert} operation against the smugglers.
translation: Полиция провела тайную операцию против контрабандистов.

definition: describing something in detail
sentence: Her {descriptive} writing makes you smell the sea in every chapter.
translation: Её описательная проза заставляет чувствовать запах моря в каждой главе.

definition: the sudden loss of power or success, or its cause
sentence: Pride was the {downfall} of the young king.
translation: Гордыня стала причиной падения молодого короля.

definition: the process of giving people more control over their lives
sentence: The programme aims at the {empowerment} of women in rural areas.
translation: Программа направлена на расширение возможностей женщин в сельской местности.

definition: a set of beliefs about what is right, especially about work
sentence: Her strong work {ethic} came from years on the family farm.
translation: Её сильная трудовая этика родом из многолетней работы на семейной ферме.

definition: a natural ability to do something well and with style
sentence: He has a {flair} for cooking that no school could teach.
translation: У него талант к готовке, которому не научит ни одна школа.

definition: a return to your home after a long time away, or a celebration of it
sentence: The soldier's {homecoming} filled the station with cheering.
translation: Возвращение солдата домой наполнило вокзал ликованием.

definition: covered with ice, or extremely cold, or unfriendly
sentence: Drive slowly; the road is {icy} after last night's frost.
translation: Поезжай медленно, дорога обледенела после ночного мороза.

definition: the ability to know something without reasoning or proof
sentence: Her {intuition} told her the man was lying.
translation: Интуиция подсказывала ей, что мужчина лжёт.

definition: extremely useful
sentence: The map was {invaluable} when the phone signal died.
translation: Карта оказалась бесценной, когда пропал сигнал телефона.

definition: a container with a lid and a spout for boiling water
sentence: Put the {kettle} on and we will have a cup of tea.
translation: Поставь чайник, выпьем чаю.

definition: not strict or careful enough
sentence: Security at the gate was {lax} and nobody checked our bags.
translation: Охрана на входе была нестрогой, и никто не проверил наши сумки.

definition: a gas with no colour or smell that burns easily
sentence: Cows produce large amounts of {methane}, which warms the planet.
translation: Коровы производят много метана, который нагревает планету.

definition: the feeling that you are going to vomit
sentence: The smell of fish gave her a wave of {nausea}.
translation: От запаха рыбы её накрыла волна тошноты.

definition: relating to the nerves and the brain
sentence: The accident left him with a {neurological} injury that affects his speech.
translation: После аварии у него неврологическая травма, влияющая на речь.

definition: the best or most suitable
sentence: The {optimum} temperature for the wine is twelve degrees.
translation: Оптимальная температура для вина — двенадцать градусов.

definition: by a very large amount or majority
sentence: The town voted {overwhelmingly} to keep the library open.
translation: Город подавляющим большинством проголосовал за сохранение библиотеки.

definition: relating to country life, or to a priest's care of people
sentence: The painting shows a {pastoral} scene of sheep and a shepherd.
translation: На картине пасторальная сцена с овцами и пастухом.

definition: relating to the way the body works
sentence: Stress causes {physiological} changes such as a faster heartbeat.
translation: Стресс вызывает физиологические изменения, например учащённое сердцебиение.

definition: birds such as chickens and ducks kept for their eggs and meat
sentence: The farm sells eggs and {poultry} at the Saturday market.
translation: Ферма продаёт яйца и птицу на субботнем рынке.

definition: the state of being important, famous or easy to notice
sentence: The young lawyer rose to {prominence} after one famous case.
translation: Молодой адвокат стал известен после одного громкого дела.

definition: a group of four musicians or singers, or music written for them
sentence: A string {quartet} played during the wedding dinner.
translation: Во время свадебного ужина играл струнный квартет.

definition: in a complete and extreme way
sentence: The city has changed {radically} since the port closed.
translation: Город радикально изменился с тех пор, как закрылся порт.

definition: acting in response to events rather than planning ahead, or quick to react chemically
sentence: The government's {reactive} policy came too late to stop the floods.
translation: Запоздалая реакция правительства не остановила наводнения.

definition: limiting what people can do
sentence: The {restrictive} visa rules keep many students away.
translation: Жёсткие визовые правила отпугивают многих студентов.

definition: done by machines that work on their own, or stiff like such a machine
sentence: The factory uses {robotic} arms to weld the car doors.
translation: На заводе двери автомобилей сваривают роботизированные манипуляторы.

definition: the written text of a film, with dialogue and instructions
sentence: She wrote the {screenplay} in six weeks and the film in a year.
translation: Она написала сценарий за шесть недель, а фильм снимали год.

definition: relating to earthquakes, or very large in effect
sentence: The {seismic} activity under the volcano has increased this month.
translation: Сейсмическая активность под вулканом в этом месяце усилилась.

definition: a college that trains people to become priests
sentence: He spent four years at the {seminary} before becoming a priest.
translation: Он провёл четыре года в семинарии, прежде чем стать священником.

definition: towards one side, or with one side facing forward
sentence: The crab moved {sideways} across the wet sand.
translation: Краб двигался боком по мокрому песку.

definition: the captain of a ship or a sports team, in informal speech
sentence: The {skipper} ordered the crew to lower the sails.
translation: Шкипер приказал команде опустить паруса.

definition: quickly and without any delay
sentence: The nurse moved {swiftly} from bed to bed.
translation: Медсестра быстро переходила от кровати к кровати.

definition: a written copy of something spoken, or the act of making it
sentence: The {transcription} of the interview ran to forty pages.
translation: Расшифровка интервью заняла сорок страниц.

definition: in a way that is true of only one person or thing
sentence: The island is {uniquely} placed to study migrating birds.
translation: Остров уникально расположен для изучения перелётных птиц.

definition: not based on what is likely or possible
sentence: It is {unrealistic} to expect the bridge to be ready in a month.
translation: Нереалистично ожидать, что мост будет готов через месяц.

definition: a very large container for holding liquid, used in factories
sentence: The grapes are crushed and left in a huge {vat} to ferment.
translation: Виноград давят и оставляют бродить в огромном чане.

definition: the place where a person or thing is
sentence: Police are trying to find the {whereabouts} of the missing driver.
translation: Полиция пытается установить местонахождение пропавшего водителя.

definition: a small printed sheet of paper that gives information or advertises something
sentence: A {leaflet} about the new bus routes came through the door.
translation: В дверь бросили листовку о новых автобусных маршрутах.

definition: a large brown bear from North America
sentence: A {grizzly} fished for salmon at the top of the waterfall.
translation: Гризли ловил лосося у вершины водопада.

definition: to praise something too much, or to make it seem better than it is
sentence: Films that {glorify} war should not be shown to children.
translation: Фильмы, прославляющие войну, не следует показывать детям.

definition: a person who looks after a building
sentence: The school {caretaker} locks the gates at six.
translation: Школьный сторож запирает ворота в шесть.

definition: a bed on a ship or train, or a place where a ship stops
sentence: We booked a {berth} on the night ferry to Ireland.
translation: Мы забронировали спальное место на ночном пароме в Ирландию.

definition: something that might happen in the future, or a plan for it
sentence: The budget includes money for every {contingency}.
translation: В бюджете заложены деньги на любой непредвиденный случай.

definition: the human mind and the deepest feelings
sentence: The war left a deep mark on the nation's {psyche}.
translation: Война оставила глубокий след в душе народа.

definition: a part of a machine that turns, especially the blades of a helicopter
sentence: The helicopter's {rotor} spun faster as it lifted off.
translation: Ротор вертолёта закрутился быстрее, когда тот взлетал.

definition: a person whose job is to find new people for a company or army
sentence: A {recruiter} called to ask if she would consider a new job.
translation: Рекрутер позвонил спросить, не рассмотрит ли она новую работу.

definition: to put something completely into a liquid, or to become deeply involved
sentence: {Immerse} the jar in boiling water for ten minutes.
translation: Полностью погрузи банку в кипящую воду на десять минут.

definition: a person who is new to an activity and has little experience
sentence: As a {novice}, she stayed on the easy ski slopes.
translation: Будучи новичком, она каталась только на лёгких лыжных склонах.

definition: to make an agreement official by signing it or voting for it
sentence: Parliament must {ratify} the treaty before it takes effect.
translation: Парламент должен ратифицировать договор, прежде чем он вступит в силу.

definition: a failure of a machine to work correctly
sentence: A {malfunction} in the signals stopped every train for an hour.
translation: Сбой сигнализации остановил все поезда на час.

definition: a strong band in the body that holds bones together at a joint
sentence: He tore a {ligament} in his knee during the match.
translation: Во время матча он порвал связку в колене.

definition: to respect and admire someone or something very deeply
sentence: The villagers {revere} the old teacher who taught three generations.
translation: Жители деревни глубоко чтут старого учителя, обучившего три поколения.

definition: a state of wild uncontrolled excitement or activity
sentence: The sale started a {frenzy} of shoppers at the doors.
translation: Распродажа вызвала безумный ажиотаж у дверей.

definition: a person whose job is to measure land or check the condition of buildings
sentence: The {surveyor} found damp in the walls of the old house.
translation: Инспектор обнаружил сырость в стенах старого дома.

definition: to give something as an honour or gift, in formal language
sentence: The university will {bestow} an honorary degree on the author.
translation: Университет присвоит автору почётную степень.

definition: a small camp or town far from the main centre, often military
sentence: The soldiers spent the winter at a lonely {outpost} in the hills.
translation: Солдаты провели зиму на одиноком аванпосте в холмах.

definition: a short chain of amino acids, part of a protein
sentence: The new drug is a {peptide} that copies a hormone in the gut.
translation: Новое лекарство — пептид, повторяющий гормон кишечника.

definition: a ship with guns used in war
sentence: A {warship} anchored outside the harbour during the crisis.
translation: Во время кризиса военный корабль встал на якорь у входа в гавань.

definition: to throw something with great force
sentence: Angry fans began to {hurl} bottles at the referee.
translation: Разъярённые болельщики стали швырять бутылки в судью.

definition: to eat something quickly and hungrily, or to read something eagerly
sentence: The children will {devour} the whole cake in minutes.
translation: Дети проглотят весь торт за считанные минуты.

definition: to shake slightly because you are cold or frightened
sentence: We began to {shiver} as the wind came off the sea.
translation: Мы задрожали, когда с моря подул ветер.

definition: the part of a road used by vehicles
sentence: Do not step into the {roadway} until the light is green.
translation: Не выходи на проезжую часть, пока не загорится зелёный.

definition: to get a free ride in a stranger's car, or to fasten with a rope
sentence: We had to {hitch} a ride to town when the bus never came.
translation: Нам пришлось добираться до города автостопом, когда автобус не пришёл.

definition: a black sticky material used to make road surfaces
sentence: The new {asphalt} on the road was still soft in the heat.
translation: Свежий асфальт на дороге в жару был ещё мягким.

definition: the line of bones down the middle of the back, or the most important part
sentence: Small farms are the {backbone} of the region's economy.
translation: Мелкие фермы — основа экономики региона.

definition: a very heavy snow storm with strong wind
sentence: The {blizzard} closed every road out of the valley.
translation: Метель перекрыла все дороги из долины.

definition: a noisy rough fight involving several people
sentence: A {brawl} broke out in the car park after the match.
translation: После матча на парковке началась драка.

definition: relating to the sky or space, or to heaven
sentence: Sailors used {celestial} bodies like the sun and stars to find their way.
translation: Моряки ориентировались по небесным телам: солнцу и звёздам.

definition: the way a writer creates and describes characters, or the description of something
sentence: The novel's {characterization} is so good that you forget the people are invented.
translation: Персонажи в романе выписаны так хорошо, что забываешь об их вымышленности.

definition: used to introduce the opposite of what has just been said
sentence: Cities need more housing; {conversely}, villages have empty homes.
translation: Городам нужно больше жилья; в деревнях, наоборот, дома пустуют.

definition: a woman of high rank, or the wife of a count or earl
sentence: The {countess} opened her gardens to the public every June.
translation: Графиня каждый июнь открывала свои сады для публики.

definition: usual, or done according to the customs of a place
sentence: It is {customary} to take off your shoes at the door here.
translation: Здесь принято снимать обувь у входа.

definition: clearly, or in a way that is noticeably different
sentence: I {distinctly} remember locking the door.
translation: Я отчётливо помню, что запирал дверь.

definition: the sound of guns being fired, or the shots themselves
sentence: We heard {gunfire} from the hills all night.
translation: Всю ночь мы слышали стрельбу с холмов.

definition: a trick that makes people believe something that is not true
sentence: The bomb threat turned out to be a {hoax}.
translation: Угроза взрыва оказалась ложной тревогой.

definition: too small or unimportant to matter
sentence: The difference in price was {insignificant}, so we chose the nicer one.
translation: Разница в цене была ничтожной, поэтому мы выбрали ту, что красивее.

definition: knowing a lot about a subject
sentence: The guide was {knowledgeable} about every building in the old town.
translation: Гид знал всё о каждом здании старого города.

definition: women's underwear and night clothes
sentence: The shop sells silk {lingerie} at very high prices.
translation: Магазин продаёт шёлковое нижнее бельё по очень высоким ценам.

definition: the soft substance inside bones that makes blood cells
sentence: The patient needs a {marrow} transplant from a matching donor.
translation: Пациенту нужна пересадка костного мозга от подходящего донора.

definition: extremely good or enjoyable
sentence: We had a {marvelous} evening with old friends and good wine.
translation: Мы провели чудесный вечер со старыми друзьями и хорошим вином.

definition: able to cure illness, used about plants and substances
sentence: The monks grew {medicinal} herbs in the garden behind the church.
translation: Монахи выращивали лекарственные травы в саду за церковью.

definition: relating to the medical care of children
sentence: She works in the {pediatric} ward of the city hospital.
translation: Она работает в детском отделении городской больницы.

definition: to change something so it suits one person, or to add their name to it
sentence: You can {personalize} the mug with a name or a photo.
translation: Кружку можно персонализировать, добавив имя или фото.

definition: full of fun and not serious
sentence: The {playful} puppy chased its own tail round the garden.
translation: Игривый щенок гонялся за собственным хвостом по саду.

definition: unusual in an attractive or interesting way
sentence: The cafe has a {quirky} charm, with chairs that do not match.
translation: У кафе своеобразное очарование: ни один стул не похож на другой.

definition: the set of reasons behind a decision or belief
sentence: The minister explained the {rationale} for closing the small schools.
translation: Министр объяснил обоснование закрытия маленьких школ.

definition: the act of improving a system, or the religious movement of the 1500s
sentence: The {reformation} of the tax system took a whole decade.
translation: Реформирование налоговой системы заняло целое десятилетие.

definition: the science of designing and building robots
sentence: She studied {robotics} and now builds machines that pick fruit.
translation: Она изучала робототехнику и теперь строит машины для сбора фруктов.

definition: rain that flows off the land into rivers, or a second vote for a winner
sentence: Farm {runoff} carries fertilizer into the lake every spring.
translation: Сток с полей каждую весну несёт в озеро удобрения.

definition: a hot red sauce that you eat with chips
sentence: Dip the chips in the {salsa} before it gets warm.
translation: Макай чипсы в сальсу, пока она не нагрелась.

definition: showing feelings of love or sadness too strongly, or valued for memories
sentence: The old watch has only {sentimental} value; it stopped years ago.
translation: Старые часы дороги только как память, они давно остановились.

definition: happening at exactly the same time
sentence: The two explosions were {simultaneous}, so nobody could tell which came first.
translation: Два взрыва прогремели одновременно, и никто не мог сказать, какой был первым.
